'''Feemor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The first [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] to [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], Feemor was successfully [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] to Knighthood by Jinn, who was in turn granted the title of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Jinn later took a young boy named [[Xanatos]] as his second student, but the latter [[Telosian Civil War|turned]] against his Master. Jinn's failure as Xanatos's teacher prompted him to dismiss his previous success with Feemor's training.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Feemor&mdash;''get him!|Xanatos, to Feemor, during their fight against Jinn|<ref name="Dark Side 1" />}}
The son of a [[Farm/Legends|farmer]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Feemor was chosen to be [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Feemor was taken as<ref name="Dark Side 1" /> the first [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]<ref name="EPI VD" /> at some point after Jinn brought a young boy named [[Xanatos]] to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="1st Padawan">Although the sources mentioning [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn's]] first [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] remain vague on the exact [[Time/Legends|time]] when Jinn took Feemor as his apprentice, it must have happened after Jinn discovered [[Xanatos]] and brought him to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], since Xanatos is mentioned in a flashback in ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Death of Hope]]'', in which Jinn is only considering to take his first Padawan.</ref> Under Jinn's guidance, Feemor successfully became a Jedi Knight. His Knighthood also saw Jinn promoted to the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Jinn then took Xanatos as his second student.<ref name="EPI VD" />

[[File:Jinn_Feemor_duel.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Feemor spars with his former Master.]]
In [[53 BBY/Legends|53 BBY]], Feemor participated in a training [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] against Jinn and Xanatos at the heart of the Jedi Temple. Feemor and Xanatos both [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|attacked]] Jinn with their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], but he repelled all of their attacks with ease. As the fight continued, Jinn and Xanatos locked their lightsabers, and the latter told Feemor to attack Jinn from the Master's left side. Jinn used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|throw]] Feemor to the ground, but in doing so Jinn loosened the grip on his lightsaber, allowing Xanatos to knock the lightsaber out of Jinn's [[Limb/Legends|hands]] and win the fight. As such, Xanatos merely used Feemor to achieve victory for himself.<ref name="Dark Side 1" />

Xanatos boasted on his victory, priding in his noble ancestry, and Jinn had to reprimand his apprentice for such behavior. Jinn then spoke to Feemor, telling his former student that he was proud of his skills, after which Feemor left the site of the duel. Immediately thereafter, Jinn and Xanatos were assigned to quell a [[Telosian Civil War|civil war]] on Xanatos's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Telos IV]].<ref name="Dark Side 1" /> However, during the mission, Xanatos was corrupted by wealth and power and rebelled against his Master, abandoning the Jedi way. Jinn's failure with Xanatos prompted him to dismiss his earlier success as Feemor's teacher, and he began to refer to Xanatos as his first Padawan.<ref name="Databank">{{DB|character|quigonjinn|Jinn, Qui-Gon}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
After he became a Jedi Knight, Feemor came to miss his training with his Master, Qui-Gon Jinn. Feemor was visibly hurt when Xanatos admitted that he had used Feemor, stating that the latter had been destined to lose the training fight due to his humble origins. Feemor had [[Color/Legends|blond]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and a fair skin complexion.<ref name="Dark Side 1" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|As in every battle&hellip;since time immemorial&hellip;a farmer's son lies in the dirt&hellip;so the noble born might win the day!|Xanatos|<ref name="Dark Side 1" />}}
Feemor was unable to defeat his former Master in battle, as Qui-Gon Jinn easily repulsed him with the Force several [[Time/Legends|times]]. However, Jinn was proud of Feemor's skills and believed that his speed of attacks had improved since their last training. Jinn felt that Feemor was ready to take a Padawan of his own and believed that [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] would soon assign him one. Jinn also believed that said student would be lucky to have Feemor as his Master.

==Equipment==
While a Jedi, he wore brown [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]]. He wielded a [[Color/Legends|blue]]-bladed lightsaber in battle.<ref name="Dark Side 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
For many years since the introduction of Qui-Gon Jinn in the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|novelization]] of the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] and the exploration of his early life in subsequent [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] material, there existed a discrepancy regarding the number of apprentices whom Jinn had during his life. Although most sources detailing Jinn's early life&mdash;such as the [[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice|''Jedi Apprentice'']] book series by [[Jude Watson]]&mdash;stated that Xanatos was Jinn's first apprentice and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] his second,<ref name="Dark Rival">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Dark Rival]]''</ref> [[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary|''Star Wars: Episode I The Visual Dictionary'']] included a passing mention of another apprentice before Xanatos.<ref name="EPI VD" /> Authors [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[W. Haden Blackman|Haden Blackman]] planned to elaborate upon this apprentice in ''[[The Essential Guide to Episode I]]''. Blackman developed a female [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] Jedi for the role of Jinn's Padawan, but ''The Essential Guide to Episode I'' was cancelled, and [[Lucasfilm]] decided that ''The Visual Dictionary'' had been in error regarding the existence of the first apprentice.<ref name="Dan Wallace">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6598068|board=Literature|thread=****The Official NEW ESSENTIAL GUIDE TO CHARACTERS by Dan Wallace Thread****|user=[[Daniel Wallace|Dan Wallace]]|date=2002-04-26|time=2:46 PM|archivedate=20220711073021}}</ref>

In [[2002]], ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' reiterated this position by stating that Xanatos was Jinn's first apprentice.<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> However, the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 35|thirty-fifth issue]] of ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'' once again included the mention of the apprentice before Xanatos.<ref name="FactFile">{{FactFile|35|JIN 1-2|Qui-Gon Jinn}}</ref> The contradiction was finally resolved in Jinn's [[Databank (original)|Databank]] [https://web.archive.org/web/20110629021737/http://www.starwars.com/databank/character/quigonjinn/index.html entry] on [[StarWars.com]], which stated that Jinn dismissed his success in training the first apprentice after his failure with Xanatos.<ref name="Databank" /> In [[2011]], the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Jedi — The Dark Side 1|''Jedi—The Dark Side'' 1]] featured a scene of a Jedi Knight named Feemor practicing combat against Jinn and Xanatos. Subsequent dialogue in the comic implied that Feemor had once trained under Jinn.<ref name="Dark Side 1" /> The comic's writer, [[Scott Allie]], later confirmed via [[Wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]] that Feemor was Jinn's first apprentice, finally establishing the Padawan's identity almost twelve years after his offhand mention in ''The Visual Dictionary''.<ref name="Twitter Allie">{{Twitter|ScottAllie|status/71273609531895808|[[Scott Allie]]|quote=Yes, Feemor is Qui-Gon's first padawan. @EUCantina}}</ref>
